edges.reason: msg.sender is used for whitelist membership checks and per-user ticket accounting in reserveTickets
tx.origin is compared against msg.sender to reject contract callers (origin dependency)
msg.sender determines the claimable ticket count and the mint recipient in claimNFTs
msg.sender receives the contract balance via send in withdraw

block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random index computation

nftLimitPerAddressTier1 is used as the default maxPerWallet
nftLimitPerAddressTier2 overrides maxPerWallet for tier2 users
currentTicketId is incremented with SafeMath add in reserveTickets
maxNftSupply bounds currentTicketId in reserveTickets
paused flag gates the reservation flow
onlyWhitelisted flag gates the reservation flow
usersTickets mapping is read and written with SafeMath add
nftsForTeam drives the team mint loop

totalClaimed is updated in claimNFTs
totalClaimed is updated in mintTeamTickets

usersTickets is read in getUserClaimableTicketCount
currentSupply is incremented in claimNFTs
currentSupply is incremented in mintTeamTickets
revealed flag controls the tokenURI branch
notRevealedUri is returned while the collection is not revealed
baseURI is concatenated into the token URI
tier1WhitelistedUsers is replaced in whitelistTier1Users
tier2WhitelistedUsers is replaced in whitelistTier2Users
tier1WhitelistedUsers is iterated in isTier1Whitelisted
tier2WhitelistedUsers is iterated in isTier2Whitelisted
constructor calls mintTeamTickets to pre-mint team tickets
reserveTickets calls isTier1Whitelisted
reserveTickets calls isTier2Whitelisted
reserveTickets performs the tx.origin == msg.sender guard
claimNFTs calls nextToken for each claimable ticket
claimNFTs calls getUserClaimableTicketCount
mintTeamTickets calls nextToken for each team ticket
withdraw uses a low-level send to transfer the balance
nextToken derives its random index from block.timestamp
claimNFTs mints via _safeMint, triggering an external callback
mintTeamTickets mints via _safeMint, triggering an external callback
recipient onERC721Received can re-enter claimNFTs before totalClaimed and currentSupply are updated

low-level send invokes the recipient fallback allowing re-entry into withdraw

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTickets is a transient parameter fully consumed by reserveTickets
user is a transient parameter fully consumed by getUserClaimableTicketCount
_users is a transient parameter fully consumed by whitelistTier1Users
maxPerWallet is a local derived from the tier limits inside reserveTickets
_usersTickets is a local cache of usersTickets inside reserveTickets
numbersOfTickets is a local loop bound inside claimNFTs
id is the locally minted token id inside claimNFTs
currentBaseURI is a local variable of tokenURI
i is the loop counter local of isTier1Whitelisted
